title: Fixed Suspended Ceiling Fan Light
description: One original complete suspended ceiling fan and light exterior. A full ceiling canopy and long downrod carry a closed rounded motor housing. Four broad whole horizontal paddles extend on their own bounded offset root brackets with finite mount caps; the lower neck, collar and opaque lamp diffuser form one central light appearance below the rotor plane. Two full pull-control chain exteriors end in finite small grips. No turbine, mine fan or chandelier mesh is imported or rescaled: the full suspended open horizontal-paddle mounting and lower diffuser differ from a grounded tall mast/nacelle vertical rotor and a skid-mounted bellmouth duct fan. Three constant opaque PBR materials, metres Z up, true whole XY centred. One isolated fixture, zero scenes; host ceiling is omitted, and minimum displayed Z is an export datum, not a ground-support claim. No animated rotation, blade sweep, airflow, cooling, illumination, electrical circuit, mounting load, installation or safety performance claim.
